BizBlack Metal changes tax rewards and voucher threshold The daily brief for frequent flyers
 Today Topics Archive The Wallet BizBlack Metal changes tax rewards and voucher threshold
 HDFC Bank will revise BizBlack Metal rewards from December 21, 2026. Tax payments will need qualifying retail spending to unlock accelerated points. The quarterly threshold for an INR 5,000 voucher falls from INR 5 lakh to INR 4 lakh beginning in January-March 2027.
 Originally reported by livefromalounge.com · HDFC Bank BizBlack Metal Credit Card to get new reward rules: Lower milestone threshold, but a higher spending condition for Rewards on Tax payments 
 Edited by Randy Petersen 
 Nov 18 · 8:30 AM · 1 min
 Key details Effective date December 21, 2026 Retail threshold INR 50,000 per statement cycle Tax reward 4 Reward Points per INR 200 Quarterly voucher INR 5,000 at INR 4 lakh spend To qualify, holders need at least INR 50,000 in qualifying retail transactions during each statement cycle; Income Tax, Advance Tax and GST payments are excluded from that calculation. Once eligible, tax payments earn 5X points in total, combining 1X core and 4X accelerated rewards. Accelerated points on Business Essential spending are limited to 7,500 per cycle and are credited in the following billing cycle.
 The revised core rate for Income Tax and GST payments is four points per INR 200, while other eligible transactions earn five points per INR 150. The overall reward-point cap remains 1,50,000 points per statement cycle. Only settled transactions count, and reversals that reduce qualifying retail spending below INR 50,000 remove eligibility for accelerated points. Tax payments still earn core points without the threshold.
 Why it matters Tax-focused holders may get only base rewards unless they spend INR 50,000 on qualifying retail purchases each cycle. The quarterly voucher is easier to reach, but excluded tax, rent and fuel spending cannot help secure it.

 Costco keeps Citi as card issuer through 2029 
 Costco extended Citi’s role issuing its co-branded Visa card through June 19, 2029. Costco exercised the three-year option in 2024, ending speculation tied to the original 10-year agreement. The card remains Citi-issued, while its reward rates and annual certificate rules shape its value for members.

 Bilt sets deadline to retain 4% cash rewards 
 Bilt cardholders must choose whether to retain the option of earning 4% Bilt Cash on everyday spending as rewards change in 2027. New applicants must be approved and accept an offer by Dec. 31, 2026. Existing members must opt in before their card anniversary in 2027.
